svg.desc: Аналоговый индикатор - экспоненциаьлные показания на фоне цвета качества

rt:model.rt:sub: Sub ValCalc() If pv == Nothing Then ValStr = "- - -" ValColor = Color_ANA_ER_LINK Else ValStr = PRJSPEC.CExp(pv.Value, NumDig) End If If (pv_AZ == Nothing) Then ValColor = Color_NB(pv) Else If (pv.Value > pv_AZ.Value) Then ValColor = Color_ANA_HI_A ElseIf (pv.Value > (pv_AZ.Value * 105.0 / 107.0)) Then ValColor = Color_ANA_HI_P Else ValColor = Color_ANA_GOOD End If End If End Sub
rt:model.rt:event: Set pv = ANA(PointID) If PointID_AZ != "NULL" Then Set pv_AZ = ANA(PointID_AZ) End If ValColor = Color_ANA_ER_LINK

Dim s As String If pv == Nothing Then s = "Ошибка привязки.
PointID = "" + PointID + """ ShowWarning (s, 0) ElseIf (PointID_AZ != "NULL") && (pv_AZ == Nothing) Then s = "Ошибка привязки.
PointID_AZ = "" + PointID_AZ + """ ShowWarning (s, 0) ElseIf (pv_AZ.Value > pv.RangeHigh) || (pv_AZ.Value < pv.RangeLow) Then s = "Ошибка.
Величина уставки
вышла за диапазон." ShowWarning (s, 0) ElseIf (PointID_AZ == "NULL") Then Call_Win ("ws_ANA_NB", pv.PVId + "|" + CStr(NumDig)) Else s = pv.PVId + "|" + pv_AZ.PVId Open_Win_Uni(False, "wi_" + PointID, "Составной объект " + pv.CategoryText, "wi_MultyPV", s) End If

Dim s As String If pv == Nothing Then s = "Ошибка привязки.
PointID = "" + PointID + """ ShowWarning (s, 0) ElseIf (PointID_AZ != "NULL") && (pv_AZ == Nothing) Then s = "Ошибка привязки.
PointID_AZ = "" + PointID_AZ + """ ShowWarning (s, 0) ElseIf (pv_AZ.Value > pv.RangeHigh) || (pv_AZ.Value < pv.RangeLow) Then s = "Ошибка.
Величина уставки
вышла за диапазон." ShowWarning (s, 0) ElseIf (PointID_AZ == "NULL") Then LoadPopUpMenu(pv.PVId + "|ANAi|ws_ANA_NB " + pv.PVId + "|"+CStr(NumDig)) Else TmpBuffer(0) = pv.PVId TmpBuffer(1) = pv_AZ.PVId LoadPopUpMenu(PointID + "|NONi|") End If
